decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix is only loosely tied to the firm's engineering core and has thin web evidence, but it is cheap to carry, so the firm keeps it while it searches for better uses of its resources.
The modular plant extensions build on the core waste-to-energy offer and use existing engineering capabilities, so they fit the firm's aspirations and carry low risk.
The waste oil to energy plant has its own web page, which signals priority and positive early results within the firm's core technology base, so management keeps it.
Results for the plastic-to-fuel plant are still uncertain, but it is close to the firm's core and the growing industry gives enough slack to carry it while it matures.
